final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM gender_counts) SELECT gc.gender, gc.n, gc.n - a.avg_n FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN avg_count a WHERE gc.n > a.avg_n
